m: नट् (Prākṛ. for नृत्, q.v.) cl. 1. P. नटति (Dhātup. xix, 19; ix, 23) to dance, Kāv.; to hurt or injure, Vop. (cf. उन्-√ नट्) : Caus. नाटयति (Dhātup. xxxii, 12) to represent anything (acc.) dramatically, act, perform, imitate, Mṛcch.; Śak. &c.; to fall (cf. √ नड्); to shine, Vop.
a: नट् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (नटति, the न not changed to ण after प्र in the sense of ‘hurting’) 1 To dance; यदि मनसा नटनीयं Gīt. 4. --2 To act. --3 To injure (by a deceptive trick). --Caus. (नाटयति-ते) 1 To act, gesticulate, represent dramatically (in dramas); शरसंधानं नाटयति Ś. 1. &c. --2 To imitate, copy; स्फटिककटकभूमिर्नाटयत्येष शैलः… अधिगतधवलिम्नः शूलपाणेरभिख्यां Śi. 4. 65. (N. B. नट् forms नटयति in the sense of ‘causing to dance’; Bh. 3. 126). {vII.v} {c10c} U. (नाटयति-ते) 1 To drop or fall. --2 To shine. --3 To injure.
